<!--
  The form of AuthCard: the fields of the mode (sign-in, sign-up, reset, magic link), remember me and the forgot
  link, the terms, the submit button.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { AuthLabels } from "../blocks/auth-card.types";

  export type AuthFormProps = {
    id: string;
    mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
    labels: AuthLabels;
    submit: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Checkbox from "../primitives/checkbox/checkbox.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { id, mode = "signin", labels, submit }: AuthFormProps = $props();
</script>

<Form method="dialog" class="gap-4" data-testid="auth-form">
  {#if ((mode as string) === "signup")}
    <Field label={labels.name} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-name", id)}>
      <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" id={tpl("{0}-name", id)} data-testid="field" />
    </Field>
  {/if}
  <Field label={labels.email} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-email", id)}>
    <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
  </Field>
  {#if (((mode as string) !== "reset") && ((mode as string) !== "magic"))}
    <Field label={labels.password} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-password", id)}>
      <Input
        type="password"
        name="password"
        autocomplete={(((mode as string) === "signup") ? "new-password" : "current-password")}
        id={tpl("{0}-password", id)}
        data-testid="field"
      />
    </Field>
  {/if}
  {#if ((mode as string) === "signin")}
    <Group justify="between" align="center" class="flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class={cn("w-fit", "")}>
        <Checkbox name="remember" id={tpl("{0}-remember", id)} />
        <Label for={tpl("{0}-remember", id)} class="text-sm">
          {labels.remember}
        </Label>
      </Group>
      <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm">
        {labels.forgot}
      </Link>
    </Group>
  {/if}
  {#if ((mode as string) === "signup")}
    <Group gap="2" align="center" class={cn("w-fit", "")}>
      <Checkbox name="terms" id={tpl("{0}-terms", id)} />
      <Label for={tpl("{0}-terms", id)} class="text-sm">
        {labels.terms}
      </Label>
    </Group>
  {/if}
  <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" class="w-full" data-testid="submit">
    {submit}
  </Button>
</Form>
